---
title: "Project 2: Modeling and Communication"
---

## Purpose

Project 2 builds on Project 1. Your group will use a simple model to analyze a question, check model assumptions, and communicate conclusions honestly.

## Required Elements

Your report must include:

1. Refined research question.
2. Dataset and variables used for modeling.
3. Data preparation steps.
4. Model choice and justification.
5. Model output and interpretation.
6. Diagnostic checks.
7. Limitations and possible improvements.
8. Final conclusion.
9. AI-use appendix.

## Modeling Standard

A model is not complete when code runs. It is complete when you can explain:

- what the model assumes;
- what each important parameter means;
- what the residuals suggest;
- where prediction or interpretation is unsafe.
